lineage: S105 established that a fresh FVG plus a 20-bar liquidity sweep and an exact 2-4 ATR sweep stop was positive after stress costs but statistically weak. S106 keeps that geometry, replaces the binary two-of-three micro gate with attention-based position sizing, and tests a farther 24-hour external-liquidity target.

common_rules.global_direction: S101 asymmetric daily UP/DOWN/SIDEWAYS regime; SIDEWAYS is flat for S106.
common_rules.local_direction: Closed 4h EMA50 trend must agree with the trade side.
common_rules.formation: S105 one-hour displaced FVG/IFVG state machine; zone age <=24h.
common_rules.entry: A 15m sweep of the previous 20 closed bars, reclaim/rejection, then a later break; fill at the next 5m open.
common_rules.stop: Exact sweep extreme plus 0.15 ATR; accept only decision stops between 2.0 and 4.0 ATR; never widen artificially.
common_rules.attention: No minimum micro confirmations. OI expansion, aligned dual taker flow and relative volume each add 0.25 to risk scale: 0.25/0.50/0.75/1.00. Veto only when both taker measurements oppose the intended side.
common_rules.risk: 0.2% equity capped at $0.50, multiplied by signal attention scale; 75% notional; leverage <=5; one global position.

predeclared_variants.fixed_control: Attention-sized S105 geometry with unchanged fixed 2.5R target.
predeclared_variants.external_target: Target 90% toward the opposite extreme of the prior 96 closed 15m bars. Require >=1.5R at decision and actual fill; cap take-profit at 2.5R when more space exists. This is the S106 candidate.

historical_gate_for_external_target.primary: Stress >=24 fills, PnL >0, PF >1.10, DD <=5%, severe PnL >0, both long and short non-negative, at least two symbols, two positive leave-one-out results and bootstrap p10 >0.
historical_gate_for_external_target.portability: Stress >=12 fills, PnL >0, PF >1.05, severe PnL >0, both long and short non-negative and at least two symbols.
historical_gate_for_external_target.time_breadth: Development, validation and retrospective stress PnL must each be positive. The opened September design month is reported but cannot count as independent validation.
historical_gate_for_external_target.promotion: A full pass can start prospective paper observation only; it cannot authorize live trading.

disclosures: BTC/ETH/SOL history and September 2026 are selection-contaminated by S103-S105 diagnostics.
The portability symbols were used by other project strategies; this is a cross-asset portability check, not pristine out-of-sample evidence.
No S106 rule may change after the first replay is opened.
